assertions: Quotation candidates retain bounded character, word, and media addressing.
Quotation marks alone are insufficient for a candidate.
Quoted-speaker and acoustic-speaker attribution remain separate.
Automatic quoted-identity binding and paraphrase inference are prohibited.
Embedded and remote speech require explicit transcript markers.
Embedded sources cannot be classified as primary participant speech.
Persistence is deterministic, reloadable, cache-safe, and tamper-evident.
CLI queues expose quotation and embedded-source review evidence.
limitations: Synthetic cues qualify mechanics rather than quotation accuracy.
Paraphrase and attributed-identity resolution require later reviewed evidence.
Embedded-source markers are transcript metadata candidates, not media-source proof.
